about.en: CGN is the token of Cygnus, a project combining a Web3 social and mini-app layer (the Cygnus InstaPlay Hub) with a modular real-yield layer that distributes on-chain yield to its users. It is an ERC-20 on Base at 0x2e6c4bd1c947e195645d2b920b827498cfaa6766 with a fixed supply of 10 billion tokens.
